title: Give every box a first value
instructions: int total; makes a box but puts nothing in it. It still holds something: junk left over in the computer's memory.
Adding to junk gives more junk. Run it and look at the strange number it prints!
int total = 0; makes the box and puts 0 in it straight away. Always give a box a first value.
task: Fix the total so the program prints:  We ate 14 slices
hint:
Start the box at 0:

    int total = 0;
